notes:
TCC Website 0.12.0: one plugin, with Planning Center events built in

- TCC Planning Center Sync is now part of this plugin, which is renamed
  "TCC Website". Volunteers have one plugin to look after: switch it off and
  the website stops working the way it should.
- Planning Center events has its own switch on TCC Website > Features. Off, it
  stops the hourly check and hides its screen, the Dashboard box and the box
  on each event. It starts off on a new install.
- One menu: TCC Website > Planning Center, Features, Search and Help. The
  Planning Center help is now a section of the Help page.
- The Dashboard box counts "on the website" the same way the Planning Center
  tab does.
- Before installing: deactivate and delete the old TCC Planning Center Sync
  plugin. Its settings carry over because the names are unchanged. If they
  were deleted, set Planning Center up again: switch it on, paste the
  Application ID and Secret, and redo Tags, Rooms and the default graphic.
